reviews.text:
I have the full size version of this sun stick and love it, so was pleased to see the mini, which is perfect for carrying in my handbag. 

I like to use liquid sunscreens first thing, but this is great for top-ups throughout the day. 

It’s lightweight and not greasy at all and I love the velvety feeling on my skin after using this, which will be due to the dimethicone. It also doesn’t leave any white cast and is easy to blend into the skin.

The silicone case is cute and good for attaching to key rings so that you don’t forget to use it. The stick does need to be completely removed from the case in order to use it.

Definitely recommend this and I’m going to try the liquid version next.
reviews.zh:
我有呢款防曬棒嘅正裝版本，好鍾意，所以見到細裝版本好開心，好啱放喺手袋入面。

我通常第一步用液體防曬，但係呢款就好適合日間補擦。

佢質地輕盈，完全唔油膩，我好鍾意用完之後皮膚上嗰種絲滑感，我估係因為含有 dimethicone。佢亦唔會留白，容易推勻落皮膚。

矽膠盒子好可愛，可以掛喺鎖匙圈上，咁就唔會忘記擦。要用就必須將防曬棒完全從盒中取出嚟。

非常推薦，下一步我會試吓液體版本。

reviews.text: Useful, but key holder parts are not very good quality.
reviews.zh: 好用，但係鎖匙扣部件質素唔太好。

reviews.text: my second repurchase. I like how they have a mini version and it comes with a key ring too. But what I love most how gentle this sunstick is. Once you apply it, it has a cooling and refreshing feel unto your skin.
reviews.zh: 係我第二次回購。我好鍾意佢有細裝版本，仲送咗個鎖匙扣。但係我最鍾意嘅係呢支防曬棒好溫和。塗咗之後，皮膚有種清涼、舒爽嘅感覺。

reviews.text: A very good social protection stick, convenient in a small format, hung on a bag and went. It also has a matte finish, which gives the advantage that it is not sticky and does not leave marks on clothes.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅日常防曬棒，細細件好方便，掛喺袋上就可以出門。佢仲係啞光質地，好處係唔會黏，亦唔會喺衣服上留印。

reviews.text: This is a great product for travelling/being out all day as it’s easy to reapply. I have dry skin and it feels hydrating and glides on easily
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好啱旅行或者成日喺外面，因為易於補搽。我嘅皮膚係乾性，用起嚟有保濕感，容易推開。

reviews.text: I really like this little sun stick! It is very convenient to carry around and the mini size is perfect for keeping in my bag. The stick glides smoothly over the skin and feels light and refreshing, with a nice cooling feeling. It doesn't feel too heavy or sticky, which is very important to me when using sunscreen during the day. The cute design is also a big plus. I will definitely keep using it!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢支細細嘅防曬棒！攜帶好方便，細裝版本好啱放喺袋入面。防曬棒喺皮膚上推得好順滑，感覺清爽輕盈，帶有好舒服嘅清涼感。唔會太厚身或者黏膩，呢點對我嚟講非常重要，因為日間用防曬時最緊要呢啲。設計可愛又係一大加分。我一定會繼續用！

reviews.text: The packaging is very cute and handy and honestly can't go wrong with this sun stick, it fits in my bag easy or on it and glides easily on the skin. Not sticky and nice on makeup.
reviews.zh: 包裝好可愛、好方便，老實講呢支防曬棒絕對冇得輸，放入袋入面或者掛喺袋上都好啱，塗落皮膚好順滑。唔黏，疊喺妝上面都好好。

reviews.text: I LOVE, IT IS NOTHING GRAPHY, IT IS ABSORBES SUPER RAPIDO, DO NOT LEVE WHITE AND ALSO LEVE, THAT YOUR PRESENTATION IS AS CREMA, BUT LEVE NOTHING, SCELLENT, IT HAS A LIKE ANYTHING OF ROMA BUT ONLY WHEN YOU APPLICATION, AND BEEN INVISIBLE
reviews.zh: 我超級鍾意，IT IS NOTHING GRAPHY，吸收超快，唔會留白，亦都唔會留低（LEVE），你嘅 PRESENTATION 好似 CREMA 咁，但係乜都唔留低，SCELLENT（好正），有啲似 ROMA 嘅嘢，但係只係塗嗰陣，而且 BEEN INVISIBLE。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
